title: How Fast Should a Model Commit to Supervision? Training Reasoning Models on the Tsallis Loss Continuum
abstract: arXiv:2604.25907v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The standard recipe for training reasoning models---SFT on rationale annotations followed by RLVR---relies on rationale annotations being available and clean. When no annotated rationales exist, SFT cannot start at all, and when the model is too unaligned, RLVR alone stalls at cold start; when annotations are weak, SFT memorizes the errors. Using the Tsallis $q$-logarithm, we define a loss family $J_Q$ that interpolates between RLVR (at $q{=}0$, the exploitation pole) and the log-marginal-likelihood over latent trajectories (at $q{=}1$, the density-estimation pole). The standard pipeline corresponds to a stepwise $q{=}1 \to q{=}0$ schedule, and intermediate $q$ enables training in regimes where the two-step pipeline cannot apply. All members share the same gradient direction, differing only by a per-instance amplification $P_{\theta}^{-q}$ that reweights each instance independently of the learning rate. translated_title: 模型应多快地投入监督？在 Tsallis 损失连续统上训练推理模型
translated_abstract: 训练推理模型的标准流程——先在推理依据标注上进行SFT（监督微调），再进行RLVR（基于可验证奖励的强化学习）——依赖于推理依据标注既存在又干净。当不存在推理依据标注时，SFT根本无法启动；当模型过于未对齐时，仅靠RLVR会在冷启动阶段停滞不前；而当标注质量较差时，SFT会记住这些错误。利用 Tsallis q-对数，我们定义了一个损失函数族 J_Q，它在 RLVR（q=0 处，即利用极点）与潜在轨迹的对数边际似然（q=1 处，即密度估计极点）之间进行插值。标准流程对应于一个分段式的 q=1→q=0 调度，而中间的 q 值使得在两步流程无法适用的训练情形下也能进行训练。该损失族的所有成员共享相同的梯度方向，仅通过一个逐实例的放大因子 P_θ^(-q) 加以区分，该因子独立于学习率地对每个实例进行重新加权。在梯度流分析下，
tldr: 该论文提出基于 Tsallis q-对数的统一损失族 J_Q，在 RLVR 与潜在轨迹对数边际似然之间连续插值，并证明标准 SFT→RLVR 流程只是其分段调度特例，从而在缺乏干净推理标注、两步流程失效的场景下也能训练推理模型。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a unified Tsallis q-logarithm loss family J_Q that continuously interpolates between RLVR and the log-marginal-likelihood over latent trajectories, showing that the standard SFT-then-RLVR pipeline is a special stepwise schedule and enabling training of reasoning models in regimes where the two-step pipeline fails.
